chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Muhassin ibn Ahmad from Yunus ibn Ya'qub who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who performs an Umrah al-Mufradah (standalone Umrah), from where does he cut the Talbiyah? He said: 'When you see the houses of Dhi Tuwa, then cut the Talbiyah.'

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: The Talbiyah (the ritual invocation: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk)
key_terms.ذِي طُوًى: Dhi Tuwa (a place near Mecca, boundary for Ihram)

ai.seo_question: Where does one stop reciting the Talbiyah when performing Umrah al-Mufradah?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific geographical marker for terminating the *Talbiyah* during *Umrah al-Mufradah*, identifying the houses of Dhi Tuwa as the boundary. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing the precise moment of concluding the ritual proclamation of God's greatness, ensuring the pilgrim's transition into the core rites of Umrah is performed with exactitude according to the Imams' teachings.
